pattern: log buffer overflow / diagnostic entries dropped under burst load
root_cause: Diagnostic logging ring buffer is undersized for burst logging; writer-thread backpressure causes entries to be dropped.
recommended_action: Increase the ring buffer size and enable lossless overflow-to-disk for diagnostic logs.

pattern: PMU brownout / undervoltage on VDD_CORE during load transient
root_cause: Power sequencing and load-transient margin are insufficient; VDD_CORE droops below the brownout threshold under a fast load step.
recommended_action: Retune the PMU load-transient response and enforce VDD_IO-before-VDD_CORE power sequencing.

pattern: timing analysis tool used for safety-relevant signoff is not in the qualified toolchain manifest
root_cause: ISO 26262 tool qualification (TCL) lapsed; safety-relevant clock signoff was performed with an unqualified STA tool version, so the signoff evidence is invalid.
recommended_action: Re-run clock tree signoff with a qualified STA tool version and restore tool-qualification evidence before release.

pattern: power estimation model drift; predicted vs measured power diverges
root_cause: The power estimation model calibration is stale; the characterization corner no longer matches current silicon.
recommended_action: Recalibrate the power estimation model against current silicon characterization data.

pattern: memory controller uncorrectable multi-bit ECC error, persistent after scrubbing
root_cause: A persistent hard multi-bit fault exists in a DRAM bank; ECC can detect but not correct multi-bit errors, and scrubbing cannot clear a hard fault.
recommended_action: Retire the affected address range / bank, trigger the safety fault reaction, and schedule hardware inspection.

pattern: OTA firmware update fails and automatic rollback does not complete
root_cause: The A/B slot swap flag is not cleared on a failed OTA update, so rollback stalls and the device can boot the staging image instead of the last-known-good slot.
recommended_action: Fix the OTA slot-swap state machine to atomically clear the swap flag and force rollback to the last-known-good slot on failure.

pattern: spurious GPIO interrupts / interrupt storm on an input pin
root_cause: The input pin lacks a debounce/glitch filter, so electrical noise produces spurious edges and an interrupt storm.
recommended_action: Enable the GPIO debounce filter on the affected input pin and add a glitch-suppression threshold.

pattern: PLL loses lock or output jitter exceeds spec on a safety clock
root_cause: PLL loop margin is insufficient under voltage droop; lock is lost and output jitter exceeds the spec limit for the safety clock domain.
recommended_action: Increase PLL loop stability margin and validate lock behavior across voltage/temperature corners for the safety clock.

pattern: CAN controller enters bus-off after an elevated bit-error rate
root_cause: An elevated bit-error rate on the CAN safety channel drives the transmit error counter past 255, forcing the controller into bus-off.
recommended_action: Investigate the physical layer / termination on the CAN safety channel and confirm the bus-off recovery strategy meets the safety concept.

pattern: thermal sensor stuck / implausible flat reading, plausibility check fails
root_cause: The thermal sensor channel is stuck (frozen reading); the plausibility cross-check against a neighbor sensor correctly flags it as implausible.
recommended_action: Diagnose the stuck sensor channel (wiring/ADC) and confirm the safe-state reaction to loss of a thermal input.

pattern: TRNG online health test fails / entropy below threshold
root_cause: The TRNG entropy source degraded and the online repetition-count health test tripped; conditioning is running on a reduced entropy pool.
recommended_action: Service the entropy source, force a reseed, and hold random-consuming operations until the health test passes.

pattern: LBIST fault coverage below the ASIL diagnostic-coverage target
root_cause: Scan/LBIST fault coverage for the safety island is below the ASIL-C target, leaving an undetected-fault gap that violates the diagnostic-coverage requirement.
recommended_action: Add test points / patterns to raise LBIST coverage above the ASIL-C target and re-evaluate the diagnostic coverage metric (ISO 26262).

pattern: safety requirement has no linked verification in the traceability matrix
root_cause: A safety requirement (watchdog fault-reaction timing) is missing its verification link, so there is an unverified safety requirement — a traceability gap that violates ISO 26262.
recommended_action: Create and execute the missing verification, then link the result to the requirement to close the traceability gap before release.

pattern: requirements traceability tool drops trace links on export
root_cause: The traceability export routine intermittently drops links, producing inconsistent matrices between output formats. Tooling bug, not a design defect.
recommended_action: Fix the export serialization so link counts are consistent across formats and add a post-export link-count assertion.

pattern: sensor fusion produces NaN / diverges on edge input
root_cause: The Kalman filter update is numerically unstable under near-singular covariance, producing NaN / large divergence on adversarial edge inputs.
recommended_action: Use a Joseph-form covariance update with conditioning/clamping and add edge-input tests to the fusion validation suite.

pattern: cache coherency stale line / near-deadlock under invalidation race
root_cause: A cross-core invalidation race lets a stale cache line be read and can drive the coherency protocol toward deadlock on the safety-critical core.
recommended_action: Fix the invalidation ordering in the coherency protocol, add directed race tests, and confirm no impact to the safety-critical core.

pattern: elevated single-bit ECC correction rate on a memory bank
root_cause: The single-bit ECC correction rate on a bank exceeds the monitoring threshold; errors are corrected but the rising rate indicates a degrading bank.
recommended_action: Monitor the bank, schedule proactive scrubbing, and evaluate whether the trend warrants retiring the bank under the safety concept.
